description: Hash, verify and identify password hashes — for seeding users, migrating auth systems, writing htpasswd files and auditing leaked hash formats. hash: bcrypt, Argon2id / Argon2i (where the server has libargon2), PBKDF2-SHA256 / SHA512 (Django format), SHA-512 / SHA-256 crypt (Linux shadow) and Apache APR1 (htpasswd). verify: checks a password against bcrypt, Argon2, crypt ($1$ $5$ $6$, DES), APR1, Django / Werkzeug / passlib PBKDF2, phpass ($P$ $H$, WordPress), Drupal 7 ($S$), LDAP {SSHA} / {SHA} / {SSHA256} / {SSHA512} / {SMD5}, MySQL 4.1+ and unsalted MD5 / SHA / NTLM hex. identify: algorithm, parameters and a verdict against the OWASP Password Storage Cheat Sheet, with needsRehash. Passwords are never echoed or stored. Price: $0.002 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/password-hash

iterations.description: PBKDF2 iterations (default OWASP: 600,000 SHA256 / 210,000 SHA512) or crypt rounds (default 656,000)

username.description: apr1: also return an htpasswd line

name: password_hash
title: Password Hash
